answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can run every identity through a prism of independent checks — one verified credential, one bonded stake, one attestation trail — so a single fake splits into three costs instead of one. Like an orchard, each identity must be planted, tended, and observed over seasons before it bears fruit; a farm that must grow a thousand slow trees cannot flood the market overnight. And like a zephyr, reputation should drift only with sustained, verifiable work, so a gust of fresh identities carries no weight until it has blown steadily for epochs.
